title: malvastrum glomeratum
intro: Malvastrum glomeratum, commonly known as the cluster poppy mallow, is a plant species belonging to the family Malvaceae. It is traditionally used for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of wounds, skin irritations, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Malvastrum glomeratum include its ability to soothe and calm irritated skin and mucous membranes, making it a popular treatment for skin conditions and gastrointestinal issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, triterpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
